annual.note: Both bases use the July 2026 four-for-one split basis. Outstanding performance awards are included at the disclosed target count. Existing acquisition founder holdbacks are reserved at full payout. Options use assumed 50% volatility and a 4% risk-free rate.
annual.noteZh: 两个基期均采用2026年七月一拆四后的口径。未结算绩效奖励按披露目标股数计入，现有收购创始人延期款按全额支付预留。期权假设波动率50%、无风险利率4%。

limitations: Both annual and TTM shares and awards use the four-for-one July 2026 split basis. Profitability must improve after recurring employee compensation; no blanket stock-compensation addback.
limitationsZh: 年度和近十二个月的股数及奖励均采用2026年七月一拆四后的口径。盈利改善须包含持续员工薪酬，不会将全部股权薪酬加回。
businessSummary: Cloud endpoint, identity and security operations subscriptions.
businessSummaryZh: 云端终端、身份及安全运营订阅。
rationale: 18% initial growth moderates reported subscription momentum.22% mature GAAP margin requires recurring SBC intensity and acquisition overhead to decline; reported losses are retained at the starting date.
rationaleZh: 初期18%增长较申报订阅势头放缓。成熟期22%GAAP利润率需要持续股权薪酬占比及收购管理成本下降；起点保留申报亏损。
